visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of hands pulling a large, smooth ball of pale dough out of a stainless steel mixing bowl onto a white marble countertop. In the background, a small digital scale and other kitchen supplies are visible under bright, even lighting. The camera is steady, focusing on the texture of the dough. (2) The scene shifts to the dough being divided. A hand uses a white plastic bench scraper to portion the dough into smaller pieces on the marble surface. The person then uses both hands to skillfully roll each portion into a smooth, round ball. A digital scale sits nearby, suggesting precise measurement. (3) The rounded dough balls are transferred onto a dark-colored baking sheet. A hand reaches in to cover the tray with a sheet of clear plastic wrap, ensuring it is sealed. A text overlay briefly appears on a black screen indicating a time jump of 1.5 hours, signifying a proofing period. (4) After the time jump, the plastic wrap is removed. A hand uses a long, grey marble rolling pin to flatten one of the dough balls into a thin, rectangular sheet on the countertop. The background remains consistent, showing a clean, well-lit domestic kitchen environment. (5) A white plate containing various toppings is brought into view. It holds slices of pink ham, shredded yellow cheese, and blocks of white cream cheese. The person begins to distribute the cheese and ham pieces evenly across the surface of the flattened dough rectangles. (6) The camera provides a wider shot showing the creator, a woman with dark hair in a beige sweater, working at the kitchen counter. She rolls up the dough sheets and stacks them. Using the bench scraper, she cuts the stacked dough into several thick, vertical strips. (7) In a tight close-up, hands pick up one of the dough strips, which reveals layers of ham and cheese inside. The hands stretch the dough slightly, twist it into a rope-like shape, and then join the ends together to form a small, circular wreath. (8) The finished dough wreaths are arranged neatly on baking sheets. A hand slides the trays into a built-in oven, where the interior light is on. Later, the woman is seen brushing a golden liquid, likely egg wash, over the surface of the partially baked bread. (9) The camera focuses on the final result: the bread has turned a deep golden brown and the cheese is melted. The woman removes a tray from the oven. Close-up shots highlight the flaky, soft texture of the bread as it is placed on a wire cooling rack. (10) The bread is served on a white plate alongside a fresh green salad topped with nuts and sliced avocado. In the final shot, hands tear a piece of the bread apart, showcasing the steaming, soft interior and the savory fillings of ham and melted cheese.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 這週幫女兒做麵包的時候. (2) [Subtitle]: 麵團已經發酵好了. (3) [Subtitle]: 結果中間臨時有事我必須要出門. (4) [Subtitle]: 我就先把麵團分割好放到烤盤上. (5) [Subtitle]: 保鮮膜刷一點油蓋起來放到冰箱冷藏. (6) [Slogan]: 1.5小時之後. (7) [Subtitle]: 大概一個多小時之後回家. (8) [Subtitle]: 麵團也醒好了. (9) [Subtitle]: 剛好可以接著整形. (10) [Subtitle]: 真的太棒了. (11) [Subtitle]: 今天做的是鹹口味的麵包. (12) [Subtitle]: 我用 mozzarella、cream cheese 還有培根當內餡. (13) [Subtitle]: 放到麵團上把三個麵團疊在一起. (14) [Subtitle]: 再分割成16個等份. (15) [Subtitle]: 然後拿起其中一個麵團. (16) [Subtitle]: 慢慢地把它拉長. (17) [Subtitle]: 捲一捲然後頭尾再黏起來. (18) [Subtitle]: 這樣的造型很像一個小花圈一樣. (19) [Subtitle]: 之後再發酵60分鐘之後就可以進烤箱囉. (20) [Subtitle]: 這麵包真的滿柔軟的也很好吃. (21) [Subtitle]: 裡面的 cheese 跟培根非常地加分. (22) [Subtitle]: 早上回烤一下就外酥內軟. (23) [Subtitle]: 配個生菜吃超滿足喔. (24) [Subtitle]: 女兒跟兒子把這個麵包帶去學校也很方便. (25) [Subtitle]: 這一週的早餐又解決啦.
